title: RedDirt Public Data Engine → Constitutional Capitalism (RCIP consumer contract)
central_diagnosis_alignment: Architecture ahead of evidence — this bridge exists to convert official statistical infrastructure into reproducible baseline proof without importing campaign systems.
governing_rule: RedDirt may provide Constitutional Capitalism with approved public statistical infrastructure, but Constitutional Capitalism may never inherit RedDirt’s campaign identity, operational data, political targeting, private records, or application dependencies.

diagram: CC   ACU   County Workbench / other civic apps
constitutional_capitalism_must_never_rec: RedDirt environment variables or API keys
broad database credentials over operational tables

forbidden_in_constitutional_capitalism: copy keys into static Astro application
receive access to all RedDirt environment variables
query RedDirt’s entire database with broad credentials
public_site_may_query: generated, source-backed JSON snapshots committed after validation
a narrow server-side public-data endpoint (later phases only if needed)

reddirt_schema_design.isolation_rule: Do not mix records with campaign tables.
reddirt_schema_design.phase_2_preference: RedDirt generates approved exports; Constitutional Capitalism does not hold live DB credentials.

phase_2_workflow: RedDirt fetches official Census/BLS (and later agency-neutral) data
Raw responses are retained or hashed for audit
Validation checks definitions, periods, geography, and units
Constitutional Capitalism imports the export into data/imports/reddirt-public-statistics/
Public pages build from the validated snapshot

agency_neutrality.rule: Architecture is agency-neutral; Census and BLS are the first ingestion hosts, not the only allowed agencies.
agency_neutrality.limitation: Census and BLS will not fill all 86 baseline indicators.

first_wave_metric_candidates.rule: Select indicators Census/BLS can authoritatively support; prove full lineage from government API → RedDirt public_statistics → validated export → CC baseline → public site before expanding.
first_wave_metric_candidates.raise_baseline_only_when: actual metrics are populated, validated, and mapped with preserved lineage — never because the bridge architecture exists

candidates.title: Homeownership
candidates.notes: ACS homeownership rate; definition must be finalized before import.

candidates.title: Wage growth
candidates.notes: CES/ECI or related BLS earnings series; unit and seasonal adjustment must be explicit.

candidates.title: Productivity
candidates.notes: Major-sector productivity indexes; align with claim CC-CLAIM-002 lineage.

candidates.title: Child poverty
candidates.notes: ACS or CPS official poverty; age universe required.

candidates.title: Business survival
candidates.notes: BDS survival measures; definition lock required.

candidates.title: Manufacturing
candidates.notes: Employment or output share — pick one unit and keep it.

candidates.title: Market concentration
candidates.notes: Concentration ratios where available; incomplete for many sectors.

candidates.title: Early-career median earnings by pathway
candidates.notes: Pathway definition still open; do not invent pathway composites.

candidates.title: Household savings
candidates.notes: May require BEA/Fed beyond BLS; keep agency-neutral mapping.

boundary_proof_requirements: audit RedDirt’s existing Census and BLS infrastructure
identify the actual database and ingestion implementation
connect exports to the 86-metric baseline via metric_mappings
prove no campaign or personal data crosses the boundary
explicitly_not_done: No live RedDirt database connection from this repo
No Census/BLS API keys stored here
No baseline values invented from this architecture
No campaign or personal data imported
Baseline scoreboard now 27/64 after ontology cleanup (historical sourced peak under pre-cleanup 86-slot registry was 27/86); RedDirt live connectors still not required for these records

public_data_engine.name: RedDirt Civic Intelligence Platform (RCIP)
public_data_engine.role: Public Data Engine for all future civic projects
public_data_engine.rule: Constitutional Capitalism must never implement Census/BLS/agency connectors; it consumes validated public measures and provenance only.

consumer_contract.rule: Constitutional Capitalism should never need to know which API produced a measure.

provenance_system.answer_standard: If anyone asks where a statistic came from, the provenance chain must answer completely.

logical_separation.rule: Distinct schemas, roles, and access controls across all three.

mapping_rules.do_not_copy_definitions_incorrectly: Lock the agency definition text before assigning a CC-IND. Prefer official table IDs and universes.
official_measure_conflicts: ACS homeownership vs SCF family homeownership
Official poverty vs SPM vs ACS poverty
Debt held by public vs gross federal debt
mapping_rules.completeness_standard: A baseline is not complete because we found a number. It is complete when another researcher can independently retrieve the same statistic and understand exactly what it measures.

first_wave_execution.redDirt_note: Phase 2 continues to prefer validated snapshots; this pass sources from primary publications with reproducible retrieval paths usable by RedDirt connectors later.
